msg: When selecting your gnome figure out which gnome gives you a red basket or yellow basket. for example purple Gnome = yellow basket, brown gnome = red basket, red gnome = red basket, green gnome = yellow basket. Once you see more mushrooms are given to yellow basket. Choose the gnome associated with the yellow basket(purple and green). once you start to see the number of mushrooms decreasing for the yellow basket associated gnome switch to selecting the red basket associated gnomes (red and brown).
